description: Source code for pathspec handling in a Git-like version control system, including functions for matching pathspecs against index entries, parsing pathspecs with magic syntax, and managing pathspec data structures.

methods.name: add_pathspec_matches_against_index
methods.description: Finds which pathspecs match items in the index and updates the seen array accordingly.

methods.name: find_pathspecs_matching_against_index
methods.description: Allocates and returns a seen array indicating the closest matches of pathspecs against the index.

methods.name: find_pathspecs_matching_skip_worktree
methods.description: Finds pathspec matches skipping worktree entries, based on the repository index.

methods.name: parse_pathspec
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into a pathspec structure, handling magic syntax and options.

methods.name: parse_pathspec_file
methods.description: Reads a file containing pathspec patterns and parses them into a pathspec structure.

methods.name: copy_pathspec
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a pathspec structure.

methods.name: clear_pathspec
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a pathspec structure.

methods.name: match_pathspec_attrs
methods.description: Checks if a given filename matches the attribute conditions specified in a pathspec item.

methods.name: pathspec_needs_expanded_index
methods.description: Determines if the index needs to be expanded based on the pathspec patterns and index state.

methods.name: pathspec_magic_names
methods.description: Generates a human-readable list of magic flags set in a pathspec.

methods.name: unsupported_magic
methods.description: Handles unsupported magic flags in pathspec patterns by terminating with an error.
